source_equation_check.source: Figure 4 dashed experimental BM3, p. 3; manual curve readings, not observations
source_equation_check.tolerance_basis: Four source-image pixels in volume, rounded up; includes dashed-line thickness, axis/readout and pressure-location ambiguity. Not a measurement uncertainty.

source_observation_comparison.notes: No pressure errors reported; volume-error confidence unspecified. No chi-square or formal significance inferred.

independent_diagnostic_refit.selection: Five nonambient Table 1 rows below 35 GPa; measured ambient row supplies fixed V0 only
independent_diagnostic_refit.objective: Equal pressure residuals, no supplied sigmas; author objective and weights unknown
independent_diagnostic_refit.notes: Published coefficients unchanged. Missing source coefficient errors and unknown constraints preclude an uncertainty-based parameter comparison.

qualification: Original experimental BM3 at 300 K, restricted to the below-35-GPa fit (last measured fit point 34.3 GPa). V0=155.4(2) A^3 is adopted from the measured Table 1 ambient cell and checked against Figure 4; the paper does not explicitly state its V0 fitting constraint. K0=167 GPa and K0_prime=6.7 are the original Table 3 values, without reported coefficient errors. Source-equation agreement is checked at graphical resolution; the separate fixed-anchor equal-pressure refit is diagnostic, not coefficient parity or recovery of author weights. Original pressures and all 14 measurements are preserved. No Litasov recalibration, 0 K DFT branch, high-pressure magnetic transition model or thermal extrapolation is substituted.
